description: This file defines an Android PreferenceActivity called DeviceAdminSample that provides a UI for managing device administration policies via DevicePolicyManager. It includes multiple nested PreferenceFragment classes for configuring various device policies such as general settings, password quality, expiration, lock/wipe features, and encryption. Additionally, it contains a DeviceAdminReceiver implementation to handle device admin events and status updates.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSample
classes.description: Main activity providing a UI for device policy management, containing nested classes for preference fragments and receiver implementations.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver
classes.description: A DeviceAdminReceiver subclass that handles device admin events and shows user feedback via toasts.

classes.name: DeviceAdminSampleReceiver2
classes.description: An empty subclass of DeviceAdminReceiver, potentially for future extensions or alternative handling.

classes.name: AdminSampleFragment
classes.description: Base class for preference fragments that provides common functionality for managing device admin policies and UI refresh.

classes.name: GeneralFragment
classes.description: Preference fragment for general device admin settings like enable/disable features and trust agents.

classes.name: QualityFragment
classes.description: Preference fragment for configuring password strength policies and parameters.

classes.name: ExpirationFragment
classes.description: Preference fragment for password expiration and history policies.

classes.name: LockWipeFragment
classes.description: Preference fragment for lock screen timing and device wipe policies.

classes.name: EncryptionFragment
classes.description: Preference fragment for managing device encryption policies.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity and device policy manager; loads preferences headers.

methods.name: onBuildHeaders
methods.description: Loads the preference headers for the activity from resource.

methods.name: isActiveAdmin
methods.description: Checks if the device admin is active.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Refreshes UI elements and policy summaries when activity resumes.

methods.name: reloadSummaries
methods.description: Updates the display summaries for various policies.

methods.name: postReloadSummaries
methods.description: Posts a runnable to update summaries asynchronously.

methods.name: onPreferenceClick
methods.description: Handles clicks on preferences, e.g., to launch activities or perform actions.

methods.name: onPreferenceChange
methods.description: Handles preference value changes to update device policies accordingly.

methods.name: doResetPassword
methods.description: Resets the device password to a new value if allowed.

methods.name: localGlobalSummary
methods.description: Formats a string showing local and global policy settings.

methods.name: showToast
methods.description: Displays a toast message with device admin event status.

methods.name: onReceive
methods.description: Handles received broadcast intents for admin events.
